spec.name: Sidi Ahmed Eddahaji Mausoleum
spec.description: The mausoleum of Sidi Ahmed Eddahaji (also known as Al-Haddaji) honors one of the celebrated seventy-five saints of Ksar el-Kebir. Associated with the Awlad Dahaj tribe, he is traditionally regarded as the patron saint of peasants and agriculturists in the region. The shrine serves as a focal point for local spiritual life, especially during the annual festival held in his honor to mark the beginning of the agricultural season.

timeline.title: Battle of Three Kings
timeline.description: According to local tradition, the saint was part of the Moroccan army during the Battle of Oued el-Makhazin (Battle of the Three Kings).

timeline.title: Annual Festival
timeline.description: A traditional festival is organized by local farmers to seek blessings for the upcoming harvest.

comments: The saint is particularly revered by the agricultural communities surrounding Ksar el-Kebir.
